article.headline: Timberwolves and Grizzlies meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Memphis Grizzlies (14-5, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (14-5, third in the Western Conference)
article.title: Timberwolves and Grizzlies meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Timberwolves and Grizzlies meet Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (14-5, fifth in the Western Conference) vs. Minnesota Timberwolves (14-5, third in the Western Conference) Minneapolis; Friday, 8:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Memphis Grizzlies travel to play the Memphis Grizzlies in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Timberwolves have gone 9-2 against Western Conference opponents. Minnesota has a 1-2 record in one-possession games. The Grizzlies are 9-4 in conference play. Memphis ranks fifth in the Western Conference scoring 50.2 points per game in the paint led by Ty Jerome averaging 8.9. The Timberwolves make 47.9% of their shots from the field this season, which is 2.9 percentage points higher than the Grizzlies have allowed to their opponents (45.0%). The Grizzlies average 14.9 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.8 more made shots on average than the 12.1 per game the Timberwolves allow. The teams square off for the second time this season. The Timberwolves won 104-95 in the last matchup on Nov. 22. Jaden McDaniels led the Timberwolves with 25 points, and Cedric Coward led the Grizzlies with 23 points. TOP PERFORMERS: LaMelo Ball is averaging 17.3 points, 5.7 assists and 1.6 steals for the Timberwolves. McDaniels is averaging 21.6 points over the last 10 games. Coward is scoring 15.3 points per game and averaging 8.2 rebounds for the Grizzlies. Jaylen Wells is averaging 2.4 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Timberwolves: 8-2, averaging 113.9 points, 45.3 rebounds, 24.5 assists, 8.6 steals and 5.5 blocks per game while shooting 48.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 104.2 points per game. Grizzlies: 8-2, averaging 122.0 points, 42.4 rebounds, 28.9 assists, 8.5 steals and 4.8 blocks per game while shooting 50.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.7 points. INJURIES: Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles), LaMelo Ball: day to day (ankle), Jaylen Clark: out (hamstring), Anthony Edwards: out (knee). Grizzlies: Scotty Pippen Jr.: out (back), Zach Edey: day to day (ankle), GG Jackson: out (foot), Jerami Grant: out (calf), Cameron Boozer: out (ankle), Richie Saunders: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
